Hi Asha —

Thanks again for running the two-week pilot with Redwood. The team was great to work with and we wanted to share a short recap of the numbers and a quick ask at the end. Attached: pilot-results-summary.pdf (2 pages).

Quick highlights from the pilot (sampled 10k requests, internal model variant B, 512 token cap):
- Average end-to-end latency: 220ms (95th percentile 560ms)
- Token cost reduction vs baseline: 48% after batching/kv-cache tweaks
- Throughput during peak test window: sustained 420 rps across reserved pool
- Accuracy / intent preservation (eval set): 92.1% pass rate on benchmark prompts

Business impact you reported during pilot: 2.3x faster triage time and meaningful drop in manual queue size — great to see.

Would you be open to two quick things?

If useful, I can also send a one-paragraph draft to make the quote ask low-effort.

Thanks again — we really appreciate the partnership.
